name: image2pptx
title: 图像到可编辑的 PowerPoint
description: Convert static images (slides, posters, infographics) to editable PowerPoint files. OCR detects text, classical CV textmask detects ink pixels, mask-clip preserves illustrations, LAMA inpaints clean background, python-pptx assembles editable text boxes with auto-scaled fonts and detected colors. Trigger on 'convert image to pptx', 'make slide editable', 'image to powerpoint', 'extract text from slide as editable', 'reconstruct slide', or when the user has a slide/poster image and wants an editable .pptx file.
